questions.question: Does before_delete_post fire when you move a post to Trash?

options.label: No — that's wp_trash_post; before_delete_post only fires on permanent deletion

feedback.correct: Correct. Trashing fires wp_trash_post. before_delete_post only fires for a hard, permanent delete.
feedback.incorrect: Trashing a post fires wp_trash_post, not this hook. before_delete_post is reserved for permanent/hard deletion only.
